about_the_game:
My Liminal Nightmare is a short first-person horror experience where you wander through a surreal labyrinth shrouded in the dark, in the search of ancient masks while being hunted down by an evil presence; Explore, survive, and face a creature that plays with your fear when the lights are out.

Will you escape the labyrinth of your own nightmare?

"There once was a saying in the great myths of old; Of a creature veiled in darkness that your dreams can take ahold. When darkness falls and crickets sing, lights are off and people sleep, with a swift and silent motion it places up on the skin, turning dreams to nightmares for him to enjoy, taking a bite every night until one is no more. He likes to play games, they'd also said, but for one to bear its curse leaves no witness to assure."

short_description: It’s common knowledge that the land of dreams is a peaceful place where no harm can reach you. But what happens when dreams turn to nightmares at the hand of an ancient evil? Once you enter its hunting grounds, be prepared to face his twisted games.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Simplified Chinese
